family: The fixed total characteristic family f_n of the language of binary strings containing at least one 1; f_0 is 0, and for n>=1 f_n(x) is OR of all n input bits, as defined in proof.md.
theorem: This one uniformly decidable total family is in NP with empty witnesses, and in the full Li-Yang B2 model C_B2(f_n)=n-1 for every integer n>=1. Consequently liminf over all integer n tending to infinity of C_B2(f_n)/n is 1.
